messages:
zoe: opened a tiny PR to add a 'sealed-site bastion proxy' quick reference for Private installs. Focus: minimal nftables/iptables examples, PKCS#11 hints for HSMs, and an offline verification line. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120
 taylor-docs: Love the one-pager idea. Keep examples copy-pasteable and add a 3-bullet troubleshooting block.
 harry: Adding minimal snippets now. nftables (ipv4):
 ```
 table ip filter { chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; ct state established,related accept; iifname "lo" accept; tcp dport 443 ct state new accept; } }
 ```
 iptables fallback: `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT`
 PKCS#11 examples: `pkcs11:token=acme;object=bastion-key` and `pkcs11:slot-id=1;object=server-cert`. Note: vendors differ on labels vs ids.
 security: add one-line: "Always verify GPG sigs and SHA256 checksums of offline artifacts before install."
 taylor-docs: troubleshooting bullets (3): tcpdump/tshark to inspect ClientHello SNI; curl --resolve example.internal:443:127.0.0.1 https://example.internal/health; check proxy TLS logs for handshake/ALPN errors.

 zoe: fixed anchor, pushed update.
